headline: PHI @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.78 at TOR 2.36, with a projected total of 7.14. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +1.41 runs while TOR moved -0.80, changing the projected margin by +2.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.61, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Ernie Clement, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Garrett Stubbs, Edmundo Sosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
